references.label: Numbered top lanes
references.description: The ten numbered lanes across the upper playfield build the current AE set.

references.label: Left and right top-return orbits
references.description: The two outside shots return the ball to the numbered upper lanes.

references.label: Center numbered star rollovers
references.description: The ten center stars score individual numbers but expose dangerous rebounds.

references.label: B-A-L-L drop bank
references.description: The upper-right bank collects the currently built AE value when completed.

references.label: Left Bonus X bullseye
references.description: The left bullseye is one of two shots that advances end-of-ball Bonus X.

references.label: Right Bonus X saucer
references.description: The saucer beside the upper lanes is the alternate Bonus X advance.
